account_contract.cost_selection_basis: actual Bybit fee applicable to the order type plus causally observed spread, estimated size-dependent slippage and market impact, and actual funding when the position crosses a funding settlement
account_contract.cost_stress_role: adverse perturbations around the realistic baseline are sensitivity diagnostics; no universal fixed 24bp number is the primary objective or mandatory selector
account_contract.funding: actual Bybit settlements when available; an explicitly adverse proxy may be used only for an early possibility screen and cannot certify the official result
account_contract.liquidation: forced liquidation invalidates the selected account path
account_contract.performance_objective: maximize sustainable realistic after-cost geometric daily growth on the continuous NAV path; 1% per UTC calendar day is a minimum completion threshold, not a cap, target-matching objective or reason to reduce risk, leverage, position size or opportunity
account_contract.position_sizing: NAV risk budget divided by structural stop loss per unit including realistic expected costs

actions_and_orders.continuation_stop: back inside accepted level plus volatility buffer
actions_and_orders.entry: first causally observable marketable minute price after completed decision plus 500ms; with 1m OHLCV this is next-minute open
actions_and_orders.model: two HistGradientBoosting regressors for after-cost structural payoff, calibrated with monotone isotonic maps
actions_and_orders.rejection_stop: beyond sweep extreme plus volatility buffer

advance_or_kill.advance: when the fully specified pre-2024 system has credible positive expectancy after the realistic cost model and no fatal causal or calculation error, freeze the complete method using information through 2023-12-31 and open official 2024H1 immediately; no fixed 24bp gate or mandatory untouched 2023H2 gate is required
advance_or_kill.kill: a structurally negative, sub-cost, sparse or winner-concentrated pre-2024 account with no credible path toward the objective closes the exact route without adjacent rescue
advance_or_kill.ranking: insert any superior hard-valid account path immediately; among valid paths prefer the highest sustainable realistic after-cost geometric growth and account multiple, including values far above 1% per day
advance_or_kill.risk_search: broad risk and leverage optimization only after positive base alpha, maximizing the full continuous account path rather than scaling performance down toward 1%
advance_or_kill.success_threshold: the project is complete only at at least 1% geometric growth per UTC calendar day over the full official 2024-01-01 through 2026-06-30 continuous NAV path; performance above 1% is retained at full strength

economic_thesis.continuation: Price obtains acceptance beyond external liquidity and continues after completed displacement/FVG structure.
economic_thesis.flat: No action when neither structural path has positive calibrated utility after realistic expected costs.
economic_thesis.payoff_scale: material intraday moves measured in fractions of a percent to several percent, not individual ticks
economic_thesis.rejection: A confirmed external-liquidity raid fails to obtain acceptance and rotates toward internal or opposing liquidity.

event_and_features.availability: all feature values end no later than the completed decision timestamp
event_and_features.confirmation: completed 5m displacement, failure and FVG geometry available by the 15m decision close
event_and_features.event: completed 15m crossing/sweep of a previously available external-liquidity level

forbidden_inputs: raw trades or quotes used as signal rows
liquidity_levels: confirmed 1h swing high/low after two right-side bars

market_scope.optional_symbol_admission: pre-2024 combined-account opportunity, growth and stability improvement

objective: Discover and causally validate a machine-learning SMC/ICT day-trading system on Bybit USDT linear perpetuals that maximizes sustainable realistic after-cost continuous-NAV geometric daily growth from minute-to-hour liquidity-auction moves; 1% per UTC day is a minimum completion threshold, never an optimization cap or de-risking target, and tick-by-tick, subsecond and queue-position alpha are prohibited.

training_and_updates.preofficial_data_use: all information available through 2023-12-31 may be used causally for feature, model, calibration, threshold and update-rule development; there is no mandatory 2023H1 calibration and 2023H2 untouched split
training_and_updates.method_selection: the exact causal time-series training, calibration and update method is a design variable that must be completed and frozen before official 2024H1 is opened; it must be chosen for expected objective impact rather than by an arbitrary holdout convention
training_and_updates.final_preofficial_fit: after the complete method is fixed, the deployable 2024H1 model may be fitted or calibrated with all data permitted by that method through 2023-12-31
training_and_updates.retraining: if periodic refitting is retained, its window, cadence and activation rule must be frozen before official evaluation; every update uses only information available when it starts and activates only after completion, while the prior model remains active

user_scope.intended_holding_scale: minutes to hours; no forced minimum and no elapsed-time liquidation
user_scope.latency_role: causal activation assumption only; never optimized or used as alpha
